'''''Play Droid''''' was a magazine in existence during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. An [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] read an issue on [[Biitu]] in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Given the title, ''Play Droid'' seems to be a parody of [[Wikipedia:Hugh Hefner|Hugh Hefner's]] acclaimed adult magazine [[Wikipedia:Playboy|''Playboy'']].
